headword: {韓国料理|かんこくりょうり}

definitions.explanation: Food and cooking traditions originating from Korea.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{韓国|かんこく}→韓国：19417_kankoku⟧ (South Korea) and ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧ (cooking, cuisine). Korean food has become extremely popular in Japan, particularly among younger generations, driven by K-pop and Korean drama cultural influence (the so-called {韓流|かんりゅう} boom).

Common Korean dishes well known in Japan include ⟦キムチ→キムチ：10838_kimuchi⟧ (kimchi), ビビンバ (bibimbap), サムギョプサル (samgyeopsal), and チヂミ (jijim, Korean pancakes).
